name: Proofpoint on Demand - Security Overview
description: This dashboard is designed to monitor email communications for compliance with both internal policies and external regulations, such as DLP and DMARC. The dashboard provides several important features, including geo-location tracking of messages from high-risk countries, a summary of policy results for DMARC, DLP, Anti-Spam and Anti-Virus, and a breakdown of messages in the quarantine folder by category. In addition, the dashboard includes a TLS message trend chart that displays the ratio of encrypted to unencrypted messages, along with insights into unencrypted sender and receiver domains. Overall, the Security Overview dashboard helps organizations maintain compliance with relevant regulations and policies, while also providing valuable insights to improve their email security posture.
title: Proofpoint on Demand - Security Overview

panels.title: Messages by Quarantine Folder

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}  
| json "guid","filter.modules.dmarc","filter.routeDirection","msg.header.from","msg.header.to","filter.disposition","connection.ip","ts","msg.header.subject","msg.header.message-id","filter.quarantine.folder","filter.isMsgEncrypted" as guid,action_dmarc,route_direction,sender_email,receiver_email,disposition,ip,time_stamp,subject,message_id,quarantine_folder,is_encrypted nodrop
| json "filter.actions[?(@.isFinal == true)].action" as final_action
| json "filter.actions[?(@.isFinal == true)].rule" as final_rule
| json "filter.actions[?(@.isFinal == true)].module" as final_module
| if ( isNull(is_encrypted), "null", is_encrypted) as is_encrypted
| replace(final_action, "[\"", "") as final_action
| replace(final_action, "\"]", "") as final_action
| replace(final_rule, "[\"", "") as final_rule
| replace(final_rule, "\"]", "") as final_rule
| replace(final_module, "[\"", "") as final_module
| replace(final_module, "\"]", "") as final_module
| where route_direction matches "{{route_direction}}"
| where final_action matches "{{action}}"
| where disposition matches "{{disposition}}"
| where is_encrypted matches "{{is_encrypted}}"
| where final_rule matches "{{rule}}"
| where final_module matches "{{module}}"
| where !isBlank(quarantine_folder)
| count_distinct(guid) as total_messages by quarantine_folder
| sort by total_messages
| limit 10

panels.title: Untitled
panels.text:
Filters: 

###route_direction:

        This refers to the direction or path that the email takes as it is sent from the sender to the recipient(s).

###disposition:

        This refers to the final outcome or status of an email message after it has been scanned and analyzed by the platform's security filters. Specifically, disposition indicates whether an email has been delivered, blocked, quarantined, or otherwise handled based on the platform's security policies.

###action:

        This refers to the ultimate decision or action taken by the platform's security filters in response to an email message.

###is_encrypted:

        This is a property that indicates whether an email message has been encrypted or not.

###rule:

        This refers to the security policy that ultimately triggered the final disposition or action taken by the platform's security filters in response to an email message.

###module:

        This refers to the specific security module or technology that was responsible for the final disposition or action taken by the platform's security filters in response to an email message.
